name: check_business_hours
description: Check current business hours, service fee, and eligibility. Call this to determine what fee to quote and whether the customer can book at the current time. Returns period (standard/after_hours/weekend/holiday), fee amount, and eligibility status.

is_hplus_member.description: Whether the customer is an H+ Member. Set to true if they confirmed H+ membership.

days_since_last_service.description: Number of days since we last serviced this customer. Use this if customer mentions recent service. Leave empty if unknown.
